question: Approve the observer-agent-pattern ideation design — Cargento-side read-only analyzer home, spike-validated no-fabrication goal derivation, three falsifiable ACs, haiku-model goal+stage+block MVP cut — to proceed to implementation?

artifacts.summary: Cargento-side read-only analyzer observes any active Pi session, derives goal+stage+one-open-block via a cheap model, writes a sidecar the session view renders. Riskiest path spiked against two real transcripts (positive + negative no-fabrication). Three falsifiable external-proof ACs. MVP cut: goal + current stage + the one open block.
